source.title: Shift Adjustment – Administrator Test Cases_Final
source.author: Bernice van der Merwe
notes: The source contains 36 scenarios. Its numbering omits TC-036; original case IDs are preserved.
Reference screenshots are baseline illustrations; reports use screenshots captured during the current run.

cases.title: Access the Shift Adjustment System
cases.prerequisite: Admin role is assigned and the user has valid Microsoft/SSO credentials.

testSteps.text: Navigate to the Shift Adjustment System application.
Enter the registered Microsoft email address and password if requested.

expectedResults.text: The Login Screen is displayed with the Login tab and SSO login option.
The credentials are accepted for authentication.
The system starts authentication.
The user is successfully authenticated and proceeds to the Home Dashboard.

cases.title: Verify Home Dashboard
cases.prerequisite: User has successfully logged into the Shift Adjustment System.

testSteps.text: Observe the Home Dashboard after login.

expectedResults.text: The Home Dashboard is displayed.
Recently created, updated, or processed records are displayed.
Recently submitted adjustments are displayed.
Total Pending Approval, Total Posting Failed and Total Recapture Requested are displayed.

cases.title: Search and Filter Shift Adjustments
cases.prerequisite: At least one shift adjustment exists and the user has access to Shift Adjustments.

testSteps.text: Open the Shift Adjustment list option.
Enter an employee name, employee number, adjustment ID, Personnel Area or Absence Type in the Search field.
Filter by Absence Type, Personnel Area and Date.

expectedResults.text: The Shift Adjustment list is displayed.
Matching records are returned based on the search criteria.
Records are filtered according to the selected status.
Records are filtered according to the selected criteria.
Auto-applied/search filters are removed and the list resets.

cases.title: Open an Adjustment from Recent Activities
cases.prerequisite: A shift adjustment is available under Recent Activities.

testSteps.text: From the Home Dashboard, locate Recent Activities.
Verify the adjustment details are available for review.

expectedResults.text: Recent adjustment records are displayed.
The capture/adjustment form opens.
The selected adjustment is displayed and can proceed to the review/update workflow.

cases.title: View and Edit an Existing Adjustment
cases.prerequisite: An existing adjustment is available to the Administrator.

expectedResults.text: The Shift Adjustment list is displayed.
The Shift Adjustment details are displayed.
Available actions are displayed.
The adjustment opens in editable mode.
The selected field can be updated.

cases.title: Cancel an Existing Adjustment
cases.prerequisite: An existing shift adjustment is available for cancellation.

expectedResults.text: The Employee Search Bar is available.
The employee can be located using the employee number.
A dropdown list displays matching employees.
The selected employee is loaded into the adjustment.
Employee name, employee number, Department, Personnel Area, Payroll area and current absence quota balances are populated.
The displayed employee information is correct before proceeding.

reviewNotes: The expected results describe employee selection rather than cancellation. The source wording is retained and requires review.

cases.title: Select Employee and Verify Auto-Populated Information
cases.prerequisite: A valid employee exists in the system and SAP information is available.

testSteps.text: Select the correct employee from the list when searching by surname.

expectedResults.text: The Employee Search Bar is available.
The employee can be located using the employee number.
A dropdown list displays matching employees.
The selected employee is loaded into the adjustment.
Employee name, employee number, Department, Personnel Area, Payroll area and current absence quota balances are populated.
The displayed employee information is correct before proceeding.

cases.title: Add Multiple Employees for Training Shift Adjustments
cases.prerequisite: Training Shift Adjustment functionality is available and multiple employees are required.

testSteps.text: Open the employee selection area for a Training Shift Adjustment.
Search for the first required employee.
Repeat the search and selection for additional employees.

expectedResults.text: The employee search/selection function is displayed.
The employee is available for selection.
The employee is added to the adjustment.
Each required employee is added to the Training Shift Adjustment.

cases.title: Upload Supporting Documents
cases.prerequisite: An adjustment is being captured and supporting documentation is available.

testSteps.text: Click “Upload” or use the drag-and-drop zone.
Select a supported PDF, JPG or PNG file.
Upload up to 5 files for the adjustment.

expectedResults.text: The Evidence Upload section is displayed.
The system allows files to be selected/uploaded.
The file is uploaded successfully if it meets the supported format and size requirements.
Up to 5 files can be attached to a single adjustment.
File images/previews are visible and files are correctly named.
The selected file is removed from the adjustment.

cases.title: Capture Absence Start and End Dates
cases.prerequisite: An employee has been selected and the absence details section is available.

testSteps.text: Locate “Absence End Date” and open the date picker.
Select an end date equal to or after the start date.
Attempt to select an end date before the start date.

expectedResults.text: The Absence Start Date field is available.
The calendar/date picker opens.
The selected start date is populated in the displayed calendar format.
The Absence End Date calendar opens.
The selected end date is populated and the date range is valid.
The system prevents or flags an invalid date range according to validation rules.

cases.title: Capture Partial-Day Absence and Total Hours
cases.prerequisite: An employee and valid absence dates have been captured.

testSteps.text: Enter a Start Time, for example 08:00.
Enter an End Time, for example 12:00.

expectedResults.text: The entered absence period is displayed.
Partial-day capture fields are displayed.
The start time is accepted.
The end time is accepted.
The system calculates Total Hours automatically.
The calculated hours accurately reflect the captured start and end times.

cases.title: Select Absence Category and Filtered Absence Type
cases.prerequisite: Employee and absence date information are available.

testSteps.text: Select the absence type matching the employee’s situation.
For SLP or MFP, verify additional requirements.

expectedResults.text: The available categories are displayed, including AWOP, UL, FR, SLP, MFP, THRD, AL and Other.
The selected category is populated.
Absence types are filtered according to the selected category.
The selected Absence Type is populated.
The system displays additional medical- related capture requirements where applicable.

cases.title: Select Absence Reason for AWOP and Sick
cases.prerequisite: An applicable AWOP or Sick Absence Type has been selected.

testSteps.text: Locate the mandatory Absence Reason dropdown.
Select an applicable reason such as AWOP or NAWP.

expectedResults.text: The Absence Reason field is displayed and mandatory.
Reasons are filtered based on the selected Absence Type.
The selected reason is populated.
The reason remains selected and the form can proceed.

cases.title: Capture Medical Location and Practitioner Information
cases.prerequisite: A medical-related absence type such as SLP or MFP has been selected.

testSteps.text: Select the location where medical attention was received/reported.
Review the Medical Practitioner Information section.
If Nurse or Other is selected, enter the Practitioner Name.
Alternatively, search for a registered practitioner.
Or add a new Medical Practitioner.

expectedResults.text: Location Type is displayed for medical-related absence types.
Available medical locations are displayed, including PMHC, Private Doctor/Hospital, Medical Clinics and Other/Unknown.
The selected location is populated.
The section is displayed for applicable medical-related absences.
Doctor, Registered Nurse, Other or blank can be selected as applicable.
Practitioner Name is accepted and mandatory for Nurse or Other.
The Search Doctors field returns filtered registered practitioners by name or practice number.
Available practitioner details are auto-populated.

reviewNotes: Nine test steps are supplied, but only eight expected results are supplied.

cases.title: Enter Additional Notes
cases.prerequisite: The adjustment capture form is open.

testSteps.text: Enter relevant additional context or details.
Save or continue with the adjustment.

expectedResults.text: The comments text area is available.
The entered information is accepted.
The comments remain associated with the adjustment.

cases.title: Review Adjustment Details Before Submission
cases.prerequisite: An adjustment has been captured, and the Review Adjustment Details page is available.

testSteps.text: Open the Shift Adjustment Details page.

expectedResults.text: The details page is displayed.
Employee name/number, Personnel Area, leave quota balances, Open Adjustments and AWOPs are displayed.
Absence category, type, reason, dates/times, partial-day details and additional information are displayed as applicable.
Uploaded documents can be viewed, downloaded or previewed.
Comments from the initiator are displayed.
System-generated error messages or failure reasons are displayed when applicable.

cases.title: Verify Adjustment Status Definitions
cases.prerequisite: Test data exists for the applicable workflow statuses.

expectedResults.text: DRAFT means the adjustment is saved but not yet submitted; action is required to complete/submit or delete.
SUBMITTED means the adjustment is awaiting approver review; no user action is required while waiting.
APPROVED means the adjustment is approved and being processed for SAP posting.
REJECTED means the adjustment will not be processed further and the rejection reason should be reviewed.
RECAPTURE_REQUESTED means corrections/additional information are required and the adjustment must be edited and resubmitted.
POSTING_FAILED indicates a SAP posting error handled by the EB team.
CANCELLED indicates the adjustment was cancelled and no further action is required unless the cancellation was in error.
CLOSE RECORD is the final state and requires no action.

cases.title: Save Adjustment as Draft
cases.prerequisite: Required information has been captured sufficiently to save a draft.

expectedResults.text: The adjustment is saved successfully.
The status changes to DRAFT.
The adjustment appears in Pending My Action.
The draft can be returned to and edited.

cases.title: Submit Adjustment for Approval
cases.prerequisite: The adjustment has been completed and required fields/documents are available.

expectedResults.text: A confirmation dialog is displayed.
The user can review the captured information before submission.
The system validates required fields and rules.
The adjustment is successfully submitted.
Status changes to SUBMITTED and the adjustment moves to the approver’s queue; a confirmation message is displayed.

reviewNotes: The source expected-result numbering skips 4 and extends beyond the four test steps.

cases.title: Approve a Shift Adjustment
cases.prerequisite: A shift adjustment is in a state requiring approver review.

expectedResults.text: The adjustment details are displayed.
The approval action is initiated.
Optional comments can be captured.
The approval is completed.
Status changes to APPROVED and the adjustment proceeds for SAP processing.

cases.title: Reject a Shift Adjustment
cases.prerequisite: A shift adjustment is available for approver review.

testSteps.text: Leave the rejection reason blank and attempt to continue.

expectedResults.text: The adjustment details are displayed.
The rejection action is initiated.
The system requires a rejection reason.
The rejection reason is accepted.
The adjustment is rejected.
Status changes to REJECTED and a notification mail is received by the Initiator.

reviewNotes: The source has seven test steps and six expected results; their numbering does not establish a reliable one-to-one match.

cases.title: Request Recapture of a Shift Adjustment
cases.prerequisite: A shift adjustment is available for approver review and requires corrections.

expectedResults.text: The adjustment details are displayed.
The recapture action is initiated.
The recapture reason is accepted.
The request is completed.
Status changes to RECAPTURE REQUESTED.
A notification mail is received by the Initiator.

cases.title: Recall a Submitted Adjustment
cases.prerequisite: A shift adjustment is in SUBMITTED status and has not yet been approved; Recall/Withdraw is available.

expectedResults.text: The Shift Adjustment list is displayed.
The relevant adjustment is displayed with SUBMITTED status.
The system initiates the recall process.
The recall reason is captured.
The adjustment is recalled.
The adjustment status changes to DRAFT.
The recalled adjustment can be edited and resubmitted.

reviewNotes: The reference expects DRAFT after recall; the existing automation expects Recalled. This difference requires review.

cases.title: Monitor Adjustment Status and Audit Trail
cases.prerequisite: An adjustment has progressed through one or more workflow actions.

expectedResults.text: A confirmation message/status information is displayed.
APPROVED, REJECTED, RECAPTURE_REQUESTED and POSTING_FAILED are displayed when applicable.
The Audit Trail is available.
Status changes are recorded.
Actions taken and timestamps are recorded in the audit trail.
Email/SMS notification is sent for applicable workflow events.

cases.title: Verify Session Timeout Behaviour
cases.prerequisite: User is logged into the Shift Adjustment System.

testSteps.text: Log in successfully and leave the application idle for the configured timeout period.
Choose to Stay Logged in / Logout.

expectedResults.text: The session remains active until the timeout threshold is reached.
The user session has expired and the user is returned to the login screen.
The user is required to re-authenticate before continuing.

cases.title: Validate Document Upload Limits and File Types
cases.prerequisite: An adjustment is being captured and the Evidence Upload section is available.

testSteps.text: Upload a valid PDF, JPG and PNG file individually.
Attempt to upload a 6th file after 5 files have already been attached.
Attempt to upload a file in an unsupported format (i.e. not PDF, JPG or PNG).

expectedResults.text: A validation error is displayed and the upload is prevented.
The upload is prevented and an error message is displayed.
Each file uploads successfully and the correct file name is displayed.

reviewNotes: The expected results appear in a different order from the upload test steps. The source wording is retained.

cases.title: Validate Mandatory Medical Practitioner Fields
cases.prerequisite: A medical-related absence type (e.g. SLP or MFP) has been selected and the Medical Practitioner section is displayed.

testSteps.text: Select “Nurse” as the Practitioner Type and leave the Medical Practitioner Name blank.
Select “Other” as the Practitioner Type and leave the Practitioner Name blank.
Select “Doctor” and leave the Doctor Information blank

expectedResults.text: Practitioner Name is not mandatory, and Adjustment can be submitted.
Practitioner Name is not mandatory, and Adjustment can be submitted.
Error displayed that Medical practitioner is required.

reviewNotes: The title refers to mandatory practitioner fields, but Nurse and Other expected results say the name is not mandatory. The source wording is retained.

cases.title: Verify Handling of a SAP Posting Failure
cases.prerequisite: An approved adjustment can be used to simulate or reproduce a SAP posting failure, or a POSTING_FAILED record is available in a test environment.

testSteps.text: Trigger or locate an adjustment that results in a SAP posting failure.
Open the failed adjustment and review the error information.

expectedResults.text: The adjustment status changes to POSTING_FAILED and the failure is logged.
The posting failure detail is available for review and coordination with the EB team.

cases.title: Capture a Single-Day Absence (Same Start and End Date)
cases.prerequisite: An employee has been selected and the absence details section is available.

testSteps.text: Select the same date for both Absence Start Date and Absence End Date.
Continue with the remainder of the capture and confirm no date-related error is raised.

expectedResults.text: The date range is accepted without validation error.
The adjustment can proceed with a one-day absence period.

cases.title: Validate Partial-Day End Time Before Start Time
cases.prerequisite: Partial Day Absence has been enabled for a captured absence.

testSteps.text: Enter a Start Time, for example 12:00.
Enter an End Time earlier than the Start Time, for example 08:00.

expectedResults.text: The start time is accepted.
The system flags or prevents the invalid time range with a validation error.

cases.title: Verify Admin Role Access on Login
cases.prerequisite: A test account with the Administrator role assigned is available.

testSteps.text: Log in using an account with the Admin role assigned.
Review the available menus and configuration options.

expectedResults.text: The user is authenticated successfully.
Admin menus and configuration options are visible and accessible.

cases.title: Verify Access Restrictions for Non-Admin Roles
cases.prerequisite: A test account without the Administrator role is available.

testSteps.text: Log in using an account that does not have the Admin role assigned.
Review the available menus and options.
Attempt to navigate directly to a configuration/admin screen.

expectedResults.text: The user is authenticated successfully.
Admin menus and configuration options are hidden or unavailable.
Access is denied.

cases.title: Update an Existing User's Details
cases.prerequisite: Administrator has access to User Management and an existing user record is available.

testSteps.text: Navigate to User Management and select an existing user.
Edit a field, e.g. role or Personnel Area assignment.

expectedResults.text: The user's current details are displayed.
The field is updated.
The changes are saved successfully and reflected on the user's record.

cases.title: Disable User Access
cases.prerequisite: Administrator has access to User Management and an existing test user account is available.

testSteps.text: Navigate to User Management and select an existing user.
Attempt to log in using the disabled account.

expectedResults.text: The user's details are displayed.
The user account is disabled.
The user is unable to log in.

cases.title: Configure Users, Roles and Personnel Areas
cases.prerequisite: Administrator has access to the Configuration screen and approved configuration requirements.

testSteps.text: Create a user by searching the AD by mail address.
Verify access based on the configured assignment.

expectedResults.text: The Configuration screen is displayed.
Users configuration is available.
A new user can be created using the available configuration.
The selected role is assigned to the user.
The Personnel Area is assigned to the user.
The user’s access is controlled according to the configured role and Personnel Area.

cases.title: Configure Reference Data and Notifications
cases.prerequisite: Administrator has access to reference data and notification settings.

testSteps.text: Configure a category and link an applicable type.
Verify Submit, Approve, Reject notifications per role.

expectedResults.text: The organisational hierarchy can be maintained.
Access control groups can be defined and maintained.
Categories, Types, Reasons and Locations can be configured.
The configured type is linked to the selected category and available according to configuration.
Practitioner records can be maintained.
Error Codes and Action Reasons can be maintained.
Notification triggers and recipients can be configured.
The notification triggers are configurable with recipients by role.
